crossRefs.note: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

translations.web: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
translations.bsb: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
translations.kjv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
translations.asv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
